description: A secret envelope (AES-256-GCM, data key wrapped under PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 with 210,000 iterations) that every SDK must open with the passphrase, giving the plaintext. Sealed on 2026-10-01 by the Java SDK: com.egradx.core.utils.EncryptionUtil.seal(plaintext, passphrase). sealedText: the same plaintext in the text form, v1:<kekSalt>:<encryptedDek>:<ciphertext>, sealed on 2026-10-02 by EncryptionUtil.sealText; every SDK must open it too.
